Maria Chen: quick check — we have a request from product to slim the debug-cache for customer-foomail and permanently remove raw session payloads > 30d. who has authority to sign off on that deletion?
Sam Patel: are these the intermittent debug snapshots under s3://redwood-debug/session-cache/ ?
Maria Chen: yep. they contain request/response dumps + some transient headers. we already redact auth tokens but not customer_id in every case.
Jordan Lee: we need two things: 1) legal approval for data erasure tied to contract, 2) confirm redaction/PII before delete. if customer asked, we can follow erase flow, otherwise default retention applies.
Anita Gomez: flagged. I'll check contract for foomail (acct FO-389). if it's a standard SaaS clause, product can request and security signoff should be fine. give me the bucket path + sample key names.
Maria Chen: path above. sample keys: session-2024-03-09-abc123.json, session-2024-02-01-def456.json
Sam Patel: operational note: deleting from the cache bucket directly will break debug replay for any ongoing investigations. suggest we snapshot the files to the archive bucket for 90 days before purge.
Jordan Lee: agree with Sam. Also run quick scan for customer identifiers. we can run this script:
```bash
python tools/scan_s3_keys.py --bucket redwood-debug --prefix session-cache/ --pattern "foomail" > /tmp/foomail-keys.txt
```
Jordan Lee: after scan, run redaction job:
```bash
python tools/redact_sessions.py --input /tmp/foomail-keys.txt --output s3://redwood-archive/foomail-redacted/
```
Maria Chen: @Anita once you confirm contract, can security give formal signoff? Product wants this done by EOD Thurs.
Anita Gomez: tentative yes on signoff if contract allows. I'll reply by EOD today.
sec-bot: Policy check result: retention-policy:default=90d; deletion-exception=false; requires-legal-approval=true. See https://corp.redwood/policies/data-retention
Sam Patel: once legal ok, I'll schedule the archive+redact job to run in maintenance window tonight. will post runbook (commands + rollback) here.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window: 2024-06-15 22:00 UTC — notification sent to #general
Jordan Lee: final thing — who approves purge from archive? that needs either legal or privacy lead. annotate ticket with approval after Anita confirms.
Maria Chen: thanks all — keeping thread here for audit trail. will update ticket RDW-2456 with links and artifacts.
